name: Octopus
description: An octopus is a marine creature known for its eight tentacles, high intelligence, and ability to change color and texture for camouflage. It is often found in diverse underwater environments, from coral reefs to the ocean depths.

actions.name: Ink Cloud
actions.description: In response to an attack roll being made against it, the octopus expels a cloud of ink in a 2 unit radius around it lasting 1 minute. Any attack made against a creature that is in the ink cloud or obscured by it has a 1d4 penalty.

actions.name: Tentacle Grasp
actions.description: The octopus uses its long, flexible tentacles to wrap around a creature that is it's size or smaller by making a grapple check with a 1d4 bonus.

actions.name: Venomous Beak
actions.description: The octopus bites a creature that it has grappled, dealing physical damage. If the attack deals damage after mitigation, the creature must make a resilience check of 5 or higher or become poisoned for up to 1 minute, dealing 1d4 poison damage each round.

traits.name: Manipulator
traits.description: The octopus has the ability to grasp and manipulate small objects.
